records.title: Configure this desktop
records.description: Desktop operator can configure this desktop. Start with an absent configuration file. Launch the desktop. Inspect resolved settings; restart after editing a local value.

acceptanceCriteria.text: First launch creates a populated per-user appsettings.json with Information by default, Microsoft at Warning, bounded rolling logs, a local LiteDB path, and a resolved Music folder.
After restart, explicit logging levels, database location, and music root take effect. Upgrades supply missing defaults and retain explicit and unknown keys.

Malformed configuration and database paths inside a share show an actionable repair state. A newly selected missing database requires explicit creation approval; an unavailable music root leaves cached browsing usable.
Diagnostics expose category, event, correlation and plugin identity where relevant. Secrets, raw CLI arguments, and private media metadata are omitted, and high-rate events are bounded.

records.title: Configure this desktop architecture
records.description: Typed JSON bootstrap, platform path resolver, and filtered ILogger providers

records.title: Isolated acceptance tests: Configure this desktop
records.description:
xUnit v3, FR only. Inject a Windows or Linux profile root, absent JSON, configured overrides, malformed JSON, and a seeded private field. Compare generated/resolved keys and filtered events.
CONFIGAcceptanceTests.Defaults_MatchesContract (FR-CONFIG-001#ac-defaults): First launch creates a populated per-user appsettings.json with Information by default, Microsoft at Warning, bounded rolling logs, a local LiteDB path, and a resolved Music folder.
CONFIGAcceptanceTests.Overrides_MatchesContract (FR-CONFIG-001#ac-overrides): After restart, explicit logging levels, database location, and music root take effect. Upgrades supply missing defaults and retain explicit and unknown keys.
CONFIGAcceptanceTests.Repair_MatchesContract (FR-CONFIG-001#ac-repair): Malformed configuration and database paths inside a share show an actionable repair state. A newly selected missing database requires explicit creation approval; an unavailable music root leaves cached browsing usable.
CONFIGAcceptanceTests.Logs_MatchesContract (FR-CONFIG-001#ac-logs): Diagnostics expose category, event, correlation and plugin identity where relevant. Secrets, raw CLI arguments, and private media metadata are omitted, and high-rate events are bounded.
Run with an independent correct fake and reject a deliberate incorrect outcome for each case. Bind the same cases and assertions to production.

records.title: Windows/Linux integration: Configure this desktop
records.description: Run first launch and restart against disposable directories. Inspect actual JSON, real LiteDB, and rolling app and worker log files.

records.title: Execute a desktop action
records.description: Desktop operator can execute a desktop action. Open Library. Invoke an action from a button, shortcut, or plugin. Observe the result after UI dispatch.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each app action submits exactly one typed Unit of Work to its handler; real validation failures and cancellation produce a typed result.
A result does not change bound UI state until a dispatcher callback applies it; a stale result cannot replace a newer view.
A long import does not block commands for UI navigation. Commands writing the same state do not expose partially applied changes.

While a background operation makes its owning UI scope logically noninteractive, that scope displays the operating system wait pointer. Completion, failure, or cancellation clears the override. Background work that leaves the scope interactive does not request the wait pointer.

records.title: Execute a desktop action architecture
records.description: Typed internal CQRS dispatcher, read projections, transaction ownership, and one Avalonia UIThread adapter

records.title: Isolated acceptance tests: Execute a desktop action
records.description:
xUnit v3, FR only. Use recording handlers and a queued fake dispatcher. Deliver query revision 2 before revision 1 and hold a fake import open while navigating.
DISPATCHAcceptanceTests.Routing_MatchesContract (FR-DISPATCH-001#ac-routing): Each app action submits exactly one typed Unit of Work to its handler; real validation failures and cancellation produce a typed result.
DISPATCHAcceptanceTests.Update_MatchesContract (FR-DISPATCH-001#ac-update): A result does not change bound UI state until a dispatcher callback applies it; a stale result cannot replace a newer view.
DISPATCHAcceptanceTests.Responsive_MatchesContract (FR-DISPATCH-001#ac-responsive): A long import does not block commands for UI navigation. Commands writing the same state do not expose partially applied changes.
Run with an independent correct fake and reject a deliberate incorrect outcome for each case. Bind the same cases and assertions to production.
Planned presentation verification (FR-DISPATCH-001#ac-wait-pointer): Hold startup with a controlled task, check the interaction-blocked state while waiting, and clear it on success, failure, or cancellation. A concurrent import or transfer leaves the logical cursor state clear. Reject inverted blocking and a stale completion that affects a new scope.

records.title: Windows/Linux integration: Execute a desktop action
records.description:
Exercise an actual Avalonia window, dispatcher, focus, modal draft and bound collection changes with background callbacks.
Planned pointer verification (FR-DISPATCH-001#ac-wait-pointer): Bind the owning Avalonia control to the system wait cursor while its action logically blocks interaction. Verify default cursor restoration and usable controls during independent background work on Windows and Linux.

records.title: Browse the music catalog
records.description: Listener can browse the music catalog. Open a cached or online catalog. Browse or search by artist, album or track. Select an available track or inspect a pending track.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Artists, albums, tracks, playlists, and search show matching catalog records and player actions.
Cached records remain browsable offline. Downloaded tracks play from the local root and pending media are identified as unavailable.

records.title: Browse the music catalog architecture
records.description: Indexed LiteDB read projections and path mapping under the configured local root

records.title: Isolated acceptance tests: Browse the music catalog
records.description:
xUnit v3, FR only. Seed album A with matching downloaded track T1 and pending track T2. Disconnect the host and compare filtering, status, and the playback request.
LIBRARYAcceptanceTests.Browse_MatchesContract (FR-LIBRARY-001#ac-browse): Artists, albums, tracks, playlists, and search show matching catalog records and player actions.
LIBRARYAcceptanceTests.Offline_MatchesContract (FR-LIBRARY-001#ac-offline): Cached records remain browsable offline. Downloaded tracks play from the local root and pending media are identified as unavailable.
Run with an independent correct fake and reject a deliberate incorrect outcome for each case. Bind the same cases and assertions to production.

records.title: Windows/Linux integration: Browse the music catalog
records.description: Open a real LiteDB cache and resolve tracks against a prepared local music tree while disconnected.

records.title: Review and apply a batch of library edits
records.description: The desktop exposes a batch-mode toggle. While enabled, every change to the library stays in the local batch until the operator approves and commits it or reverts the entire batch. Committed changes synchronize to peers.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Turning on the batch-mode toggle sends every library change, including imports, organization and file moves, removals and deletions, metadata edits and saved playlist changes, to the local batch. No library changes reach the host or peers before explicit commit.
A review dialog lists every pending change in the batch and requires explicit approval to commit the reviewed changes.
Committing the approved batch makes its library edits eligible for synchronization to registered peers. Peers receive no unapproved changes.
Reverting a pending batch restores all changes in that batch on the originating desktop and propagates none of them to peers.
Turning batch mode off with pending edits requires the user to resolve the batch through commit or revert. Closing the review leaves the pending batch intact.

records.title: Isolate and publish reviewed library edit batches
records.description: Route every library-changing intent through the same desktop-local batch boundary while its toggle is enabled. Cover scheduled and plugin-originated library writes, keeping files and records separate from the authoritative catalog and active shares until approval. Bind commit approval to an exact reviewed batch revision and publish through the authoritative library change feed.

records.title: Isolated acceptance tests: Library edit batches
records.description: For FR-LIBRARY-002#ac-batch-local, FR-LIBRARY-002#ac-batch-review, FR-LIBRARY-002#ac-batch-commit and FR-LIBRARY-002#ac-batch-revert, exercise toggle on/off, edits from every library mutation family, full review, stale approval, successful commit and full revert. Independently reject fixtures that bypass batching through import, organize/move, removal/deletion, queue auto-save or a background writer, upload or publish early, omit a change, commit the wrong revision, or leave a local edit after revert. Include FR-LIBRARY-002#ac-batch-toggle-off by proving the dirty batch survives cancellation and exits only after commit or revert.

records.title: Windows/Linux integration: Library edit batches
records.description: For FR-LIBRARY-002#ac-batch-local, FR-LIBRARY-002#ac-batch-review, FR-LIBRARY-002#ac-batch-commit and FR-LIBRARY-002#ac-batch-revert, exercise real desktop and host stores, scratch media, beets and registered peer replicas. Verify private files and records across restart, exact mixed-batch approval, commit and peer delivery, uncertain commit recovery and full revert. At the screen phase verify the toggle, complete change list and revision-bound approval dialog using the actual desktop. Include FR-LIBRARY-002#ac-batch-toggle-off by proving the dirty batch survives cancellation and exits only after commit or revert.

records.title: Play and mix music
records.description: Listener can play and mix music. Cue two local tracks. Play and blend them; switch presentation. Observe continuity and return from fullscreen.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Play, pause, seek, previous, next, volume, shuffle and repeat update a persistent queue and the active deck.
Two independently cueable decks expose per-deck transport and gain; manual crossfader and bypassable master EQ apply to the output.
Automatic crossfade uses the configured duration; manual input takes over; an incoming-track failure preserves the outgoing track and surfaces the error.
Minimum, Normal, bounded visualization, and full visualization keep the session and queue. Escape restores the prior windowed mode; missing telemetry preserves usable transport and exit controls.
When the active queue is backed by a saved playlist, the user can turn automatic saving of queue edits to that playlist on or off.
A desktop-local toggle controls whether playback of the active playlist continues automatically when the desktop application restarts.

records.title: Play and mix music architecture
records.description: SoundFlow, MiniAudio, FFmpeg, independent deck state, and one playback session

records.title: Isolated acceptance tests: Play and mix music
records.description:
xUnit v3, FR only. Use a fake backend, two tracks A and B and a controllable audio clock. Compare queue, channel targets, fade cancellation, and state before and after each mode transition.
PLAYERAcceptanceTests.Transport_MatchesContract (FR-PLAYER-001#ac-transport): Play, pause, seek, previous, next, volume, shuffle and repeat update a persistent queue and the active deck.
PLAYERAcceptanceTests.Mix_MatchesContract (FR-PLAYER-001#ac-mix): Two independently cueable decks expose per-deck transport and gain; manual crossfader and bypassable master EQ apply to the output.
PLAYERAcceptanceTests.Fade_MatchesContract (FR-PLAYER-001#ac-fade): Automatic crossfade uses the configured duration; manual input takes over; an incoming-track failure preserves the outgoing track and surfaces the error.
PLAYERAcceptanceTests.Modes_MatchesContract (FR-PLAYER-001#ac-modes): Minimum, Normal, bounded visualization, and full visualization keep the session and queue. Escape restores the prior windowed mode; missing telemetry preserves usable transport and exit controls.
PLAYERAcceptanceTests.QueueAutoSave_MatchesContract (FR-PLAYER-001#ac-queue-autosave): Load a saved playlist into the active queue. With auto-save on, apply and persist an ordered queue edit to that playlist. With auto-save off, verify a queue edit leaves the saved playlist unchanged.
Run with an independent correct fake and reject a deliberate incorrect outcome for each case. Bind the same cases and assertions to production.
PLAYERAcceptanceTests.RestartResume_MatchesContract (FR-PLAYER-001#ac-resume-playback-after-restart): Model a restart with and without the toggle enabled. Verify that an eligible saved playlist resumes only when enabled and that restoration retains the saved queue occurrence and position.

records.title: Windows/Linux integration: Play and mix music
records.description:
Verify SoundFlow native output by codec, mixer and EQ response, physical output and window transitions.
PlaybackRestartIntegrationTests.RestartResume_MatchesContract (FR-PLAYER-001#ac-resume-playback-after-restart): Restart against a disposable LiteDB playback store and the configured audio adapter. Verify opt-in playback, restore-only behavior with the toggle off, and a recoverable result if the saved track is unavailable.

records.title: Use an external playback strategy
records.description: Desktop operator can use an external playback strategy. Choose a CLI profile. Validate and switch backend; invoke transport. Observe structured status on success or an actionable error.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Profiles validate declared actions, arguments, capabilities and status mappings for one-shot commands and stdin/stdout sessions. Unsupported controls are identified.
Switching stops the prior backend, retains queue and track, and awaits explicit Play. Paths are passed as data; timeout, exit, and malformed replies are surfaced.

records.title: Use an external playback strategy architecture
records.description: Versioned YAML, direct process arguments, per-command and session strategies

records.title: Isolated acceptance tests: Use an external playback strategy
records.description:
xUnit v3, FR only. Supply synthetic one-shot and session replies for Play, an unsupported EQ action, an exit failure and a timeout. Compare the structured state and exact argument tokens.
CLIAcceptanceTests.Profiles_MatchesContract (FR-CLI-001#ac-profiles): Profiles validate declared actions, arguments, capabilities and status mappings for one-shot commands and stdin/stdout sessions. Unsupported controls are identified.
CLIAcceptanceTests.Switch_MatchesContract (FR-CLI-001#ac-switch): Switching stops the prior backend, retains queue and track, and awaits explicit Play. Paths are passed as data; timeout, exit, and malformed replies are surfaced.
Run with an independent correct fake and reject a deliberate incorrect outcome for each case. Bind the same cases and assertions to production.

records.title: Windows/Linux integration: Use an external playback strategy
records.description: Use fixture executables with spaced arguments, timeout, process exit, request/reply and malformed records in both invocation modes.

records.title: Install and run extensions
records.description: Desktop operator can install and run extensions. Select a local plugin package. Review compatibility and trust; enable it. Use its contribution or observe isolated failure.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Local plugin packages can be installed, trusted per version, enabled, disabled, updated, and removed; shared defaults cannot trust or activate code.
Validated plugin contributions render in host-owned surfaces. Visualization receives bounded available telemetry and app commands enter CQRS.
Worker timeout or crash removes its contribution while playback and navigation remain usable. Diagnostics identify plugin/version, and recovery startup disables plugins.

records.title: Install and run extensions architecture
records.description: Versioned worker IPC, declarative host rendering, local trust, ILoggerFactory SDK

records.title: Isolated acceptance tests: Install and run extensions
records.description:
xUnit v3, FR only. Supply plugin sample ID example.scope at versions 1 and 2, a valid view, an invalid view, a stale frame and a simulated dead worker. Observe trust, rendered contribution and recovery.
PLUGINSAcceptanceTests.Manage_MatchesContract (FR-PLUGINS-001#ac-manage): Local plugin packages can be installed, trusted per version, enabled, disabled, updated, and removed; shared defaults cannot trust or activate code.
PLUGINSAcceptanceTests.Visualize_MatchesContract (FR-PLUGINS-001#ac-visualize): Validated plugin contributions render in host-owned surfaces. Visualization receives bounded available telemetry and app commands enter CQRS.
PLUGINSAcceptanceTests.Recovery_MatchesContract (FR-PLUGINS-001#ac-recovery): Worker timeout or crash removes its contribution while playback and navigation remain usable. Diagnostics identify plugin/version, and recovery startup disables plugins.
Run with an independent correct fake and reject a deliberate incorrect outcome for each case. Bind the same cases and assertions to production.

records.title: Windows/Linux integration: Install and run extensions
records.description: Run real workers and send valid/invalid IPC; kill a worker during playback. Inspect categorized logs and recovery startup.

records.title: Set shared and local preferences
records.description: Desktop operator can set shared and local preferences. Open Settings. Change an eligible default or apply a local override. Inspect the effective value and source.

acceptanceCriteria.text: An explicit local override wins over a shared default, which wins over a built-in default. Clearing the override restores inheritance.
Offline operation uses the last valid shared defaults. Invalid values are rejected; credentials, local paths, plugin trust and OS registration stay local.
Contextual key mappings identify conflicts. Opt-in system playback shortcuts report OS denial and leave in-app mappings usable.

records.title: Set shared and local preferences architecture
records.description: Typed, versioned registry and revisioned host settings with device-local storage

records.title: Isolated acceptance tests: Set shared and local preferences
records.description:
xUnit v3, FR only. Use fade duration 0 built-in, 4 shared, and 2 local. Drop connectivity, clear the local override, and deny a synthetic global shortcut.
SETTINGSAcceptanceTests.Precedence_MatchesContract (FR-SETTINGS-001#ac-precedence): An explicit local override wins over a shared default, which wins over a built-in default. Clearing the override restores inheritance.
SETTINGSAcceptanceTests.Availability_MatchesContract (FR-SETTINGS-001#ac-availability): Offline operation uses the last valid shared defaults. Invalid values are rejected; credentials, local paths, plugin trust and OS registration stay local.
SETTINGSAcceptanceTests.Shortcuts_MatchesContract (FR-SETTINGS-001#ac-shortcuts): Contextual key mappings identify conflicts. Opt-in system playback shortcuts report OS denial and leave in-app mappings usable.
Run with an independent correct fake and reject a deliberate incorrect outcome for each case. Bind the same cases and assertions to production.

records.title: Windows/Linux integration: Set shared and local preferences
records.description: Propagate defaults between running desktops and exercise OS-level hotkey registrations and conflicts.

records.title: Manage the host music library
records.description: Library operator can manage the host music library. Open a library on a connected desktop. Upload, review, edit, organize or remove music. Review the resulting catalog and any errors.

acceptanceCriteria.text: An authorized desktop can open or initialize the beets library and manage supported paths, naming, import behavior and installed plugins.
Uploading makes staged copies. Guided import offers match, keep tags, or skip; failures show recoverable job state.
Tag edits reject stale revisions. Organize previews affected paths; catalog removal and audio deletion are separate choices, and deletion requires confirmation.
Partial beets changes are reconciled before publishing revisions or retrying; offline metadata mutations are unavailable.

records.title: Manage the host music library architecture
records.description: Authenticated host service, serialized journaled beets adapter, catalog reconciliation

records.title: Isolated acceptance tests: Manage the host music library
records.description:
xUnit v3, FR only. Inject a journal and fake beets results for upload A, a stale revision, a move preview, catalog removal and a write failure after one result. Compare intended changes and published revisions.
BEETSAcceptanceTests.Open_MatchesContract (FR-BEETS-001#ac-open): An authorized desktop can open or initialize the beets library and manage supported paths, naming, import behavior and installed plugins.
BEETSAcceptanceTests.Import_MatchesContract (FR-BEETS-001#ac-import): Uploading makes staged copies. Guided import offers match, keep tags, or skip; failures show recoverable job state.
BEETSAcceptanceTests.Edit_MatchesContract (FR-BEETS-001#ac-edit): Tag edits reject stale revisions. Organize previews affected paths; catalog removal and audio deletion are separate choices, and deletion requires confirmation.
BEETSAcceptanceTests.Recover_MatchesContract (FR-BEETS-001#ac-recover): Partial beets changes are reconciled before publishing revisions or retrying; offline metadata mutations are unavailable.
Run with an independent correct fake and reject a deliberate incorrect outcome for each case. Bind the same cases and assertions to production.

records.title: Windows/Linux integration: Manage the host music library
records.description: Use real beets and a disposable library, inspect staged bytes, tags, filenames, catalog revisions and partial job recovery.

records.title: Sync catalog, listening records and defaults
records.description: Registered desktop operator can sync catalog, listening records and defaults. Register two desktops. Edit from one and reconnect the other. Observe independent catch-up and conflict handling.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Registered instances can originate host changes; revocation prevents further access from that instance.
Catalog, playlists, favorites, history and eligible defaults converge through stable IDs, revisions and tombstones. Applying a page and its checkpoint is atomic.
Other registered recipients pull and acknowledge committed changes independently. Duplicate delivery does not reapply changes and an offline recipient cannot block others.
Offline playlists, favorites and history retain stable operation IDs. Plays merge by play ID and conflicting drafts survive replay and snapshot recovery.

records.title: Sync catalog, listening records and defaults architecture
records.description: Host and local LiteDB, consistent snapshots, cursor checkpoints, and durable notification delivery

acceptanceCriteria.text: The desktop and host use separate LiteDB files behind typed repository adapters. Each write transaction atomically commits the related records, operation receipts, and applicable revision or delivery state.
The C4 workspace defines the desktop and host LiteDB collections, their document keys and fields, and their logical relationships. The entity views match the repository collection inventory.

records.title: Isolated acceptance tests: Sync catalog, listening records and defaults
records.description:
xUnit v3, FR only. Register A, B and C. Deliver the same change twice to B while C is offline, then reconnect C with an expired cursor and a conflicting draft.
RECORDSAcceptanceTests.Register_MatchesContract (FR-RECORDS-001#ac-register): Registered instances can originate host changes; revocation prevents further access from that instance.
RECORDSAcceptanceTests.Replicate_MatchesContract (FR-RECORDS-001#ac-replicate): Catalog, playlists, favorites, history and eligible defaults converge through stable IDs, revisions and tombstones. Applying a page and its checkpoint is atomic.
RECORDSAcceptanceTests.Notify_MatchesContract (FR-RECORDS-001#ac-notify): Other registered recipients pull and acknowledge committed changes independently. Duplicate delivery does not reapply changes and an offline recipient cannot block others.
RECORDSAcceptanceTests.Offline_MatchesContract (FR-RECORDS-001#ac-offline): Offline playlists, favorites and history retain stable operation IDs. Plays merge by play ID and conflicting drafts survive replay and snapshot recovery.
RECORDSAcceptanceTests.RepositoryWrites_MatchesContract (FR-RECORDS-001#ac-replicate, TR-RECORDS-ARCH-001#ac-litedb-repositories): Use independent fakes for the typed repositories, reject a stale expected revision and repeated operation with different intent, and inject a failure mid-write. Verify that records, receipt, and applicable revision or delivery entries become visible together only on commit.
Run with an independent correct fake and reject a deliberate incorrect outcome for each case. Bind the same cases and assertions to production.

records.title: Windows/Linux integration: Sync catalog, listening records and defaults
records.description:
Restart live host and replicas around commit and acknowledgment, revoke an instance, and prove catch-up after expiry.
Repository and C4 verification (TR-RECORDS-ARCH-001#ac-litedb-repositories, TR-RECORDS-ARCH-001#ac-litedb-c4-entities): Use separate disposable LiteDB files to verify rollback across collections, replay receipt lookup after reopening, and atomic page and checkpoint writes. Validate the Structurizr model. LiteDbC4EntityParityTests.DesktopAndHostMappingsMatchDocumentedKeysFieldsAndRelationships compares collection inventories, keys, scoped mappings, compatibility rules and relationships. Verify first-run schema one, rejection and preservation of unsupported newer schemas, and schema-one reads that omit WasPlaying or IsDirect.

records.title: Mirror media to PCs and Android
records.description: Library operator can mirror media to PCs and Android. Pair a receiving peer. Select a layout or confirm mirror and sync. Verify playable media or diagnose share and transfer errors.

acceptanceCriteria.text: PC peers mirror the full music library, show connection and share status, and expose pause, resume and rescan. A pending file remains unavailable to play.
Each Android device can choose a validated YAML layout with independent export and share ID. New devices default to musicolet.yaml with album-based paths and relative UTF-8 M3U8 playlists.
Preview identifies file adds, moves and removals and profile-driven removals need confirmation. Interrupted exports preserve the source and other shares.

A registered Android connection immediately selects Normal UI on Sync and the peer through CQRS. Playback and modal draft/focus survive. Duplicate, desktop and historical events do not trigger navigation.

Dropping a saved playlist into a device's Sync list stages a playlist file in the selected app profile's format, preserving every track in order. Stage only audio missing at that device's export destination, reusing audio already on the device or already staged. When all audio is present, stage just the playlist file.

records.title: Mirror media to PCs and Android architecture
records.description: Syncthing REST/events and per-device send-only export trees

records.title: Isolated acceptance tests: Mirror media to PCs and Android
records.description:
xUnit v3, FR only. Inject Android and desktop IDs, overlapping template paths, one interrupted export and a modal draft. Compare export ownership, preview, allowed removals and the final selected peer.
FILESYNCAcceptanceTests.Mirror_MatchesContract (FR-FILESYNC-001#ac-mirror): PC peers mirror the full music library, show connection and share status, and expose pause, resume and rescan. A pending file remains unavailable to play.
FILESYNCAcceptanceTests.Layouts_MatchesContract (FR-FILESYNC-001#ac-layouts): Each Android device can choose a validated YAML layout with independent export and share ID. New devices default to musicolet.yaml with album-based paths and relative UTF-8 M3U8 playlists.
FILESYNCAcceptanceTests.Safety_MatchesContract (FR-FILESYNC-001#ac-safety): Preview identifies file adds, moves and removals and profile-driven removals need confirmation. Interrupted exports preserve the source and other shares.
FILESYNCAcceptanceTests.Arrival_MatchesContract (FR-FILESYNC-001#ac-arrival): A registered Android connection immediately selects Normal UI on Sync and the peer through CQRS. Playback and modal draft/focus survive. Duplicate, desktop and historical events do not trigger navigation.
FILESYNCAcceptanceTests.PlaylistDrop_MatchesContract (FR-FILESYNC-001#ac-playlist-drop): Exercise mixed and fully present device inventory, repeated or overlapping drops, and two selected app profiles with different playlist formats. Assert ordered references to every track in the formatted playlist, exactly the distinct missing audio destinations staged, and no additional audio when everything is already present.
Run with an independent correct fake and reject a deliberate incorrect outcome for each case. Bind the same cases and assertions to production.

records.title: Windows/Linux integration: Mirror media to PCs and Android
records.description:
Use two PC replicas and an Android device or the approved Google Play-enabled Android emulator with Syncthing-Fork. Verify authenticated arrival from all four desktop modes, share isolation, restart recovery and deletion propagation.
For the pre-UI checkpoint, inspect the documented Musicolet M3U8 structure, relative paths, exact playlist order and missing-audio staging, and verify the actual receiver transfer by file digest. The arrival-mode integration cases use controlled events through the application composition. Record the separate UI acceptance evidence when screens are implemented.
